adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, in `handleNewBooking`, explicitly pushes additional destination calendars for COLLECTIVE team events (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over `event.destinationCalendar` and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` for each destination. However, several calendar integrations/services shown in the diff (Lark, Office365, BaseCalendarService/iCal) and related logic (BrokenIntegrationEmail, EventManager Meet fallback) destructure only the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`) and use that single calendar for targeting/selection. As a result, when multiple destination calendars exist, those integrations will repeatedly act on the first destination calendar (potentially creating duplicate events in the first host’s calendar) and ignore the others. GoogleCalendarService is updated to select by `credentialId`, but the others are not, making multi-destination behavior incorrect/inconsistent based on the diff.
